what: The picture is built as a 3D plate of tens of thousands of short horizontal strokes (280×350 cells) — each cell gets its intensity from brightness · warmth · outline, only cells that pass a 4×4 Bayer threshold light up as strokes of cell width .72, pop forward 10~52 by intensity, and ride a five-step color ladder: base → between base and accent → accent → between accent and text → text. At first they are scattered across a sphere of radius 235~365, then gather into the first picture, when the picture changes, each stroke gets its own delay (seed×.45) and flies sideways, bending 18~60 (front-back 46~90) over 1.15s power2.inOut to settle in its new place. The plate tilts .12rad and sways by sin(.32t)×.2, rotates when dragged (easing off at 2.6/s on release, with the tilt returning over .9s power2.out), and the wheel rotates it too. When the mouse moves fast, strokes within 120px are pushed away by (8~22)px (at a speed of 700px/s, 63% of .8, rising at 18/s · falling at 5/s)

options.[data-fx-part=shape]: Image (img·canvas, named by data-key) — if the background is transparent it uses alpha, otherwise it removes the top-corner color as the background and reads the rest. data-tilt is that image’s lean (rad)
options.[data-fx-part=pick]: Menu or button that swaps to the data-key image on hover or focus
options.fx:shape: Send to an element (detail.key) to switch to that image
options.start: Name of the shape to gather first, default first shape — none means no automatic gathering (only via fx:progress)
options.wait: When an event with this name arrives on document, gathering begins first (after the boot screen — e.g. fx:booted)
options.cols · rows: Number of cells, default 280 · 350 — fewer makes strokes longer and lighter
options.fit: Panel size multiplier, default 1 (on wide screens the smaller of height-36 ÷ 530 and width×.6 ÷ 470, max 1.6)
options.--fx-ramp-0 ~ 4: Five-step color ladder (css variables), default background · between background and accent · accent · between accent and text · text
options.fx:progress: When sent to the element (detail.key, value 0~1) it draws the gathered spot by progress with that image — like a next-work strip gathered by scroll. Use together with start: none

note: The original drives mouse push through a fluid grid (velocity field, pressure solve) — here only the strength is taken, using the same speed filtering as the original, and the push is applied directly with a distance-falloff radius of 120px. Dragging works only on the panel and touch doesn’t block page scroll (pan-y).
